Nidhi Gupta, J. (Oral)
1.

By way of filing the present appeal the injured-claimant seeks enhancement of compensation
amount of 46,300/- awarded to him vide impugned Award dated 07.01.2016,, by the learned
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Ferozepur, in a claim petition bearing Mact Case No. 6 of
23.08.2014 filed under Sections 166 and 140 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
2.  The matter pertains to the year 2018 and notice of motion is yet to be issued in the same.

Perusal of the record reveals that along with the present appeal, an application bearing No. CM CM-16150-CII-2018 2018 for condonation of delay of 667 days in refilling the present appeal has also been filed.
On the last date of hearing i.e. 09.05.2023 the appellant had gone un-represented.
represented.
Today, again none has put in appearance on behalf of the appellant, despite the case having been called twice.
3. A bare reading of the above facts shows that the appellant has exhibited an utterly casual attitude in his pursuit of the present litigation.
It is to be appreciated that very valuable public time of the 1 of 2 FAO-4862 4862-2018 (O&M) -2- Court has been expended in affording opportunities to the appellant in the interest rest of justice.
On the other hand, the appellant ha has adopted an utterly ly casual and careless approach.
It is clear that neither the appellant nor his counsel is seriously interested in pursuing the present matter matter.
Thus, this Court is left with no other option option except to dismiss the same for non- prosecution prosecution.
